title: How much rice and urad dal make 6 cups of idli mix?
description: Soft idlis need rice and urad dal in the ratio two to one, and six cups of the mixture are needed. The six cups are shared into three equal groups, the same way as the example in the book, to find the rice and the urad dal.
teaching_notes: One idea: add the terms to get the number of equal groups in the whole mixture, then multiply each term by one group. Watch for students who give two cups of rice because the first term is two.

video_script.why: The child splits a cooking mixture of known total into its two ingredients by the sharing method.
video_script.substitution: Add the terms to get the groups, divide the total cups by the groups, then multiply each term by one group.
video_script.anchor: a bowl of idli mixture holding six cups, with a rice sack and a urad dal sack beside it
video_script.payoff_line: the idlis need four cups of rice and two cups of urad dal

final_answer.value: 4 cups of rice and 2 cups of urad dal
final_answer.spoken: four cups of rice and two cups of urad dal

maths_rules: rice 2 x 2 = 4 cups; urad dal 1 x 2 = 2 cups
video_script.design: One idea: terms added give the groups, one group times each term gives each ingredient. The bowl and the two sacks stay in the anchor band and the working goes on the board.
